name: Reactor MVU App (Experimental)
author: Microsoft
description: Experimental. Creates a Microsoft.UI.Reactor (WinUI 3) desktop app using the Model-View-Update pattern with UseReducer. Microsoft.UI.Reactor is prerelease and its API may change.
symbols/dotnetVersion/description: Base target framework moniker (TFM). Microsoft.UI.Reactor requires .NET 10 or later.
symbols/reactorVersion/description: Microsoft.UI.Reactor (and Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Devtools) NuGet version to reference.
symbols/windowsSdkBuildToolsVersion/desc: Microsoft.Windows.SDK.BuildTools NuGet version. Use * for the latest stable.
symbols/windowsSdkBuildToolsWinAppVersio: Microsoft.Windows.SDK.BuildTools.WinApp NuGet version. Use * for the latest stable.
symbols/skipRestore/description: If specified, skips the automatic restore of the project on create.

symbols/Packaging/choices/Packaged/descr: Packaged app with MSIX identity and package assets.
symbols/Packaging/choices/Unpackaged/des: Unpackaged app without an MSIX manifest or package assets.
